title: Draft example: outputs written by pnpm pack:build
description: Problems with inputs only. Run: pnpm pack:build docs/examples/sample-draft.json -o my-pack.json

items.title: Pair sum exists
statement: Given a list of integers nums and an integer target, return true if two different positions hold numbers that add up to target.
hints: What do you need to remember about the numbers you have already seen?
A hash set of seen numbers answers in one pass.

idea: Walk through the list once, keeping a set of numbers seen so far. For each number x, check whether target - x is in the set.

stress.label: 100000 numbers, no pair adds up to the target

items.title: Reverse the order of words
statement: Given a list of words, return them in reverse order.
hints: Be careful with an empty list.

items.title: Count the vowels
statement: Return how many of the letters a, e, i, o, u appear in the text s.
hints: Look at one letter at a time.
A string of vowels makes the check short.

idea: Loop over the letters and add one for each vowel.
